stem.en: A place has had cloudy skies and wet weather for three days. What kind of pressure is it most likely to have?

text.en: No pressure at all, because cloud blocks it

feedback.en: Every place has air pressure. Cloud does not remove it.

text.en: High pressure, with air sinking over it

feedback.en: Sinking air goes with clear and sunny skies.

text.en: Low pressure, with air rising over it

feedback.en: Yes. Rising air cools and builds cloud.

explanation.en: Low pressure goes with cloudy skies and wet weather, because rising air cools and its water vapour condenses. High pressure goes with clear and sunny skies.

hints.en: Which way must air move to build a cloud?
